subject: Tomorrow is Sri Yukteswar's Birthday – Honor with Luca
body:
Tomorrow we honor the birthday of Sri Yukteswar, Master's guru and the great Jyotish (astrologer) and teacher who guided Master's spiritual development.

Sri Yukteswar was known for his scientific approach to spirituality and his profound understanding of the cosmic laws. He taught Master the importance of balancing the material and spiritual aspects of life, and his wisdom continues to inspire seekers today.

As we honor this great teacher, let us reflect on the guru-disciple relationship and the importance of spiritual guidance on the path.

Here are some questions to explore with Luca:
{{exampleQuestions}}

May this day deepen your appreciation for the guru-disciple relationship.

In divine friendship,
The Luca Team
